subject.title: fix(feishu): guard Object.assign against prototype pollution in webhook payload merge

question: Should Feishu webhook envelope construction adopt this null-prototype contract, or should the safeguard preserve the existing object-shape contract while filtering unsafe keys?
rationale: The patch changes both hostile-key handling and the envelope prototype, so code review needs an owner decision on the supported downstream object contract.

options.title: Preserve consumer contract
options.body: Use the established safe-key guard while retaining the existing observable envelope shape, with regression coverage for hostile and ordinary payloads.

options.title: Adopt null-prototype envelopes
options.body: Accept null-prototype objects as the Feishu webhook envelope contract after confirming all downstream consumers tolerate them.

recommendation.title: Preserve consumer contract
recommendation.body: Use the established safe-key guard while retaining the existing observable envelope shape, with regression coverage for hostile and ordinary payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently contributed the adjacent repository prototype-key defense and can help route the consistency question; Feishu-specific ownership remains unconfirmed.
